children.author: Samanyu2005
children.text:
I'm not affiliated with the product, but I just tried it out and I really liked it.

I have absolutely zero video editing experience. The most basic thing I've done is just cutting clips and adding audio, but that was probably 10 years ago.

I just got to know about this and put my ChatGPT subscription to work. I took a video prompt from Grok and gave it a shot in Powermove. The result was okay, but the thing is, it hasn't stopped; it's still an ongoing process.

So midway through, it's pretty okayish, but I'm really happy with what has come out of it. And that is considering I barely know anything about video editing or motion graphics. I'm pretty sure it will take a few more iterations, but I will get something really great out of this.

What I find most exciting is that I can actually use Powermove to edit without any prior experience in video/motion editing which would take me weeks to learn.

source.text:
Both me and my cofounder are in high school, and we're currently building Powermove, a video-editing tool that connects to an AI agent, letting users modify the app featureset, and generate effects and extensions.

We think this is the next step when it comes to software. We're already starting to see it, especially since a similar feature was just added recently in Claude Code. We believe that it will prove most useful in creative software though, and allow creatives to make essentially anything they want.

As a motion designer myself with a few years of experience, it has already turbocharged my outputs. The video you're seeing above was only possible with Powermove.

It's also completely free and open source.
source.title: Show HN: Malleable video editor that adapts to your workflow
